description: This file defines a configuration class 'NebiusConfig' that extends 'OpenAIGPTConfig' for transforming parameters specific to Nebius AI Studio's chat completion API, aligning with OpenAI's API parameters.

classes.name: NebiusConfig
classes.description: A subclass of OpenAIGPTConfig that maps Nebius-specific parameters to OpenAI-compatible parameters, specifically handling 'max_completion_tokens' to 'max_tokens'.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps Nebius-specific openai parameters, such as 'max_completion_tokens', to standard openai parameters within a given parameter dictionaries.

ctags.name: map_openai_params
ctags.signature: ( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
